title: Payoff and Loan Satisfaction Statement Timing, Accrual and Rounding Schedule
content:
The Payoff and Loan Satisfaction product issues every payoff statement on the settings below. The six payoff plans share the same figures for this facet.

| Setting | Borrower Voluntary Payoff | HECM-to-HECM Refinance Payoff | Heir Retention Payoff | Estate Market Sale Payoff | Approved Short Sale Payoff | Deed in Lieu of Foreclosure |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Business days after a written payoff request within which the statement is issued (Monday to Friday, federal holidays excluded) | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 | 7 |
| Calendar days after issue through which a payoff statement's figures are good | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Annual rate from which the daily accrual on the statement is computed | note rate plus annual MIP rate | note rate plus annual MIP rate | note rate plus annual MIP rate | note rate plus annual MIP rate | note rate plus annual MIP rate | note rate plus annual MIP rate |
| Days per year used to turn the annual rate into a daily accrual | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 |
| Fee for a payoff statement | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 |
| Rounding of every computed payoff figure | half up to the cent | half up to the cent | half up to the cent | half up to the cent | half up to the cent | half up to the cent |
| Date through which daily accrual is charged on a payoff | the date the funds are received | the date the funds are received | the date the funds are received | the date the funds are received | the date the funds are received | the date the funds are received |

### Reading the schedule

- **Issue time.** Seven business days are counted on business days only: Saturdays, Sundays and federal holidays are not counted.
- **Good-through period.** The figure of 30 is a count of calendar days after the issue date, weekends and holidays included.
- **Fee.** A fee of USD 0.00 means no plan charges for the statement itself.
- **Day count.** An annual rate is turned into a daily figure by dividing it by 365 on every plan; no plan uses a 360-day year.
- **Rounding.** Every computed payoff figure is rounded half up to the cent: a third decimal of 5 or more raises the cent, a third decimal below 5 leaves it.

### Hypothetical illustrations

| Hypothetical input | Result under the schedule |
|---|---|
| A computed figure of USD 12.345 | rounded to USD 12.35 |
| A computed figure of USD 12.344 | rounded to USD 12.34 |
| A period of 30 calendar days counted from an issue date on the 4th day of a 31-day month | ends on the 3rd day of the following month |

The figures in the illustration table are chosen for demonstration only and are not fees, balances or dates of any account.
